workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: api: retain valid evidence across rejected node reports

head_commit.message:
api: retain valid evidence across rejected node reports

Preserve the latest comparable report and its original observation time in
an internal checkpoint before invalid evidence replaces the current snapshot.
Use the checkpoint after supervisor restart, prefer newer retained events
when older writers leave it stale, and clear it with successful recovery.
Keep rejected current evidence visible without publishing extra snapshots.

Do not let an older application fallback replace a newer proven kernel
confirmation. Keep checkpoint writes inside the node lock and transaction,
and preserve event timestamps, revisions and immutable evidence.

Add an empty checkpoint table without backfill and cover recovery across
software, deployment, sysctl, module, eBPF and livepatch histories, including
the synthetic supervisor restart integration scenario.

workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: nixos: support authoritative notification templates

head_commit.message:
nixos: support authoritative notification templates

Configured notification template sources were always overlaid on bundled
core and plugin defaults. That made templates intentionally omitted by a
deployment available as generic fallbacks and changed which mail request
chains could send.

Add an explicit replace mode while retaining overlay as the compatibility
default. Replacement packages contain only the configured source, and
database auto-setup cannot install bundled defaults in that mode. Cover the
registration correction and approval paths where an omitted user fallback
must suppress mail while existing admin and account-creation templates keep
working.

head_commit.message:
api: render dataset expansion mail from operation values

Expansion mail currently mixes immutable history values with mutable dataset
status, allowing a concurrent status update to report the old quota as the new
size. Manual expansion chains can also render before their quota transaction
and cumulative accounting edit execute.

Require the exact target quota and expose explicit size variables to templates.
Carry automatic targets from their processed events and manual targets from
their computed operations, including cumulative added space for repeat
expansions.

workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: nodectld: make watchdog use poll staleness

head_commit.message:
nodectld: make watchdog use poll staleness

The watchdog currently adds a second missed-heartbeat window after the
transaction poll is already stale, and its status request can itself block on
the database. This delays recovery and provides no evidence about the stuck
transaction loop.

Expose database-free monotonic health, capture the transaction-loop backtrace
at 810 seconds, and restart at 900 seconds of actual poll staleness. Bound
local RPC waits and reset wrapper signal handlers inherited by forked daemons.

head_commit.message:
nodectld: monitor VPS auto-start convergence

Add the authoritative vpsAdmin auto-start setting to the internal status RPC
and reconcile it with the osctld container inventory in nodectld's existing
status pass.

Export fresh per-VPS, aggregate, reason, and setting-drift metrics. Failed
checks clear current reconciliation data while retaining the last-success
timestamp, so Prometheus cannot alert from a stale snapshot.

The RPC extension is additive. New nodectld versions reject non-empty old API
responses without the new field instead of treating the missing value as
disabled. A reboot integration scenario covers a persistent start failure and
metric resolution after recovery.

workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: api: accept unsigned OOM task UIDs

head_commit.message:
api: accept unsigned OOM task UIDs

Host namespace UID allocations can exceed the signed 32-bit range, so valid
OOM task reports currently raise ActiveModel::RangeError before task insert.

Store host_uid and vps_uid as unsigned 32-bit integers, rejecting negative
predecessor data and lossy rollback. Add bounded task field diagnostics while
preserving the original range error as its cause and existing ingestion
semantics.

The migration alters both columns together. Supervisors must restart after it
runs to refresh cached column metadata.
